blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: For occasional difficulty sleeping. Do not exceed recommended dose. Consult a healthcare professional before use in children, if you are pregnant or nursing, have a medical condition, are taking any medication, or if you are experiencing long-term sleep difficulties. This product may cause drowsiness. Do not drive or operate machinery when taking melatonin. Not for use by those under the age of 18. Keep out of reach of children. Do not take on empty stomach. Not to be used as a substitute for a varied diet and healthy lifestyle.
California Residents: Reproductive harm. Prop 65.
Store product in a cool, dry place, away from heat, moisture and sunlight.
